chunks: Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Quran which Jibraeel (peace be upon him) brought to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was seventeen thousand verses.
ai.seo_question: How many verses are in the Quran according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) asserts that the Quran revealed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) comprised seventeen thousand verses, a figure frequently cited in Shia scholarship to support the view of a larger original corpus. While the commonly recited Uthmanic codex contains approximately 6,236 verses, this hadith highlights the distinction between the total revealed text and the preserved written compilation, a key topic in discussions of Quranic preservation and variant readings.
